description: This header file declares string formatting utility functions such as StringPrintf, StringAppendF, and StringAppendV within the android::base namespace, providing printf-like string manipulation capabilities.

methods.name: StringPrintf
methods.description: Returns a formatted string based on printf-like format and arguments.

methods.name: StringAppendF
methods.description: Appends a formatted string, based on printf-like format, to the provided string.

methods.name: StringAppendV
methods.description: Appends a formatted string, using a va_list, to the provided string.
